Verklaring aangaande de uitsluitingsgronden en/of selectiecriteria Impliciete verklaring op erewoord Door eenvoudig deel te nemen aan deze procedure tot gunning van de overheidsopdracht en door zijn aanvraag tot deelneming of offerte in te dienen, verklaart de kandidaat of inschrijver op erewoord zich niet in één van de voorziene uitsluitingsgevallen te bevinden als bedoeld in de Art 67, 68 en 69 van de wet. Wat de selectiecriteria betreft moeten de documenten en certificaten ten laatste op het uiterste tijdstip voor de indiening van de aanvragen tot deelneming of de offertes worden voorgelegd. Opmerking: de aanbestedende overheid gaat enkel voor de als opdrachtnemer in aanmerking komende inschrijver na of deze zich effectief niet in één van de voormelde uitsluitingsgevallen bevindt. De aanbestedende overheid zal in deze context een uittreksel strafregister opvragen van de natuurlijke persoon die de offerte/indieningsrapport heeft ondertekend, alsook van de rechtspersoon. Tevens behoudt ze zich het recht voor andere overtuigende stukken op te vragen. Wanneer meerdere ondernemingen deel uitmaakten van een combina

geval bevindt en corrigerende maatregelen doet gelden overeenkomstig Art 70 van de wet, slaat de impliciete verklaring op erewoord niet op elementen die verband houden met de betreffende uitsluitingsgrond. In dat geval legt hij de schriftelijke beschrijving van de genomen maatregelen voor. In het offertebiljet kan melding gemaakt worden van corrigerende maatregelen. Au niveau national, les agents du pouvoir adjudicateur, qui sont habilités à réaliser ces vérifications, font partie de MRMP-G/E/F. Les indications fournies en application des dispositions qui précèdent ne peuvent être utilisées par le pouvoir adjudicateur à d'autres fins que celle de la vérification prévue au présent titre. Seulement au cas où ce mode opératoire ne peut pas être utilisé vu que l’adjudicataire ne disposerait pas d’une adresse e-mail, le mode opératoire exceptionnel pourrait alors être appliqué. Mode opératoire normal Condition : L’adjudicataire dispose d’une adresse e-mail active où l’on peut envoyer des lettres de commande. Le pouvoir adjudicateur enverra à l’adjudicataire la lettre de commande originale munie de la signature originale digitale de l’ordonnateur compétent par e-mail (avec demande d’accusé de réception automatique). Lorsque la lettre de commande originale, revêtue d’une date et du numéro de commande (numéro PORD), est envoyée par e-mail, l’expéditeur devra, avant de l’envoyer, cocher la case “accusé de réception” en Outlook. L’expéditeur en question devra veiller à recevoir effectivement un accusé de réception et devra le conserver. Le délai effectif de livraison ou d’exécution débute le jour qui suit le jour d’envoi de l’e-mail (sauf autre disposition prévue dans la lettre de commande). Falls ja, welche Nachweise sind hierfür im Rahmen des Teilnahmeantrags bzw. Angebots erforderlich? Nein, neben festangestellten Mitarbeitenden können keine freien Mitarbeitende berücksichtigt werden (Dokument Erklärung zur Eignung, Punkt 2.2.1 Mitarbeiter) Sollten die geforderten personellen Eignungen mit den eigenen festangestellten Mitarbeitenden nicht vollständig erfüllt werden können, besteht die Möglichkeit, • eine Bietergemeinschaft zu bilden oder • eine Eignungsleihe in Anspruch zu nehmen. Die jeweils erforderlichen Nachweise sind dann gemäß den Vorgaben der Vergabeunterlagen im Angebot beizubringen. Anhaenge, Seite: 2 lfd. references_experience.text: ncil can continue to fulfil its statutory function of distributing public funding to the arts sector securely, reliably, and efficiently. The objective of this procurement is to secure a modern, cloud-hosted, configurable off-the-shelf Grant Management System capable of supporting the full grant lifecycle for applicants, assessors, panellists, and Arts Council staff. The solution will provide a secure and accessible digital platform for application management, assessment workflows, award administration, post-award monitoring, reporting, and integration with the Arts Council’s existing Finance Management System. The organisation's strategic preference is for a solution that requires minimal custom development and can be configured using standard platform functionality. The replacement programme will be delivered through a phased implementation approach centred on the successful completion of a Proof of Concept (PoC) using a live Arts Council funding programme. This approach is intended to validate vendor capability, system performance, user experience, and organisational readiness before progressing to full production deployment. The Arts Council is seeking a long-term technology partner capable of delivering a proven solution while supporting a structured, low-risk transition from the e

For further information on the Arts Council, please visit our website www.artscouncil.ie. Background and Objective The Arts Council is undertaking the replacement of its existing Grant Management System (GMS), a critical business application that underpins the administration, assessment, award, and ongoing management of public funding programmes. The current platform has been in operation beyond its supported lifecycle for over a decade and now presents significant operational, cybersecurity, governance, and business continuity risks. The replacement programme has therefore been established primarily as a risk mitigation and service continuity initiative to ensure the Arts Council can continue to fulfil its statutory function of distributing public funding to the arts sector securely, reliably, and efficiently. The objective of this procurement is to secure a modern, cloud-hosted, configurable off-the-shelf Grant Management System capable of supporting the full grant lifecycle for applicants, assessors, panellists, and Arts Council staff. The solution will provide a secure and accessible digital platform for application

e, user experience, and organisational readiness before progressing to full production deployment. The Arts Council is seeking a long-term technology partner capable of delivering a proven solution while supporting a structured, low-risk transition from the existing environment. The new system must support bilingual service delivery (Irish and English), modern digital user experiences, robust security controls, workflow automation, management reporting, and interoperability with current and future finance platforms. The solution should also align with public sector best practice, including cloud-first principles, accessibility requirements, data protection obligations, cybersecurity standards, and emerging NIS2 requirements. This procurement will be conducted through a Competitive Procedure with Negotiation to ensure transparency, value for money, and market competition. The successful solution will play a central role in enabling The Arts Council to maintain resilient grant administration services while providing a platform for future enhancement and digital innovation across the organisation. Registration is free of charge and there is no charge for documents. Please note that the Contracting Authority accepts no responsibility for information relayed (or not relayed) via third parties. Completing the Qualification Questionnaire When completing the Qualification Questionnaire contained in Appendix 1 to this Document, Candidates should note the following conditions: All questions must be completed in full using the format provided and without reference to other documents or other parts of the Qualification Questionnaire. term_value.text: ead/Coach Functie CRM Senior Architect/Technical Lead/Coach Taakomschrijving De CRM Senior Architect/Technical Lead/Coach neemt de rol van architect, coach en leider op in het development team. Dit houdt hem niet tegen om met een hands-on attitude in de technische details van een project te duiken. Hij/zij staat in voor het leiden, coachen en sturen van het team dat een bepaalde applicatie ontwikkelt. Hij/zij helpt FIT in het maken van strategische keuzes m.b.t. het applicatieplatform. Hij/zij helpt FIT bij het opzetten van de vereiste technische governance- en projectstructuur. Hij/zij zorgt ervoor dat de timing, de standaarden, het budget, de documentatieverplichtingen, de kwaliteit, enz. gerespecteerd worden. Hij/zij ondersteunt de projectleiding bij architecturale beslissingen, planning, risicoanalyse, kwaliteitsbewaking en technische governance. Hij/zij begeleidt configuratie- en implementatieteams en staat, waar nodig, zelf mee in voor configuratie. De projecten zijn meestal nieuwe ontwikkelingsopdrachten of grote onderhoudsopdrachten voor de organisatie. entity_geography.text: for Graduate Medical Education (ACGME). Requirements for board certification of competency of our trainees include broad exposure to and experience with pediatric and adult genetic disorders, including metabolic and mitochondrial disorders, complex traits, skeletal dysplasia’s, clefting, phacomatoses, and chromosomal disorders. The training must include information on the diagnosis and management of these disorders, including the opportunity to rotate in CLIA approved diagnostic genetic laboratories run by American Board of Medical Genetics (ABMG) certified staff. Another component must be the follow up of abnormal newborn screening results. Residents spend two of the 5 years training in Pediatrics at Children’s National Hospital, a world-renowned institution in metropolitan Washington, D.C. The pediatrics training is based in a diverse, urban setting and includes training experiences in the surrounding capital region. The curriculum includes rotations in subspecialty pediatrics, PICU, NICU, emergency medicine, well baby nursery, as well as inpatient and outpatient general pediatrics. Graduates are eligible to sit for the ABP board examination and well equipped to work in primary care and pediatric subspecialties. Assessment is also in very much scope and there has been substantial work done on assessment in the past. 4.10 International landscape Ireland is part of the European Higher Education Area, the European Research Area. Irish agencies and educational institutions are networked internationally. QQI, for example, is a member of ENQA (The European Association for Quality Assurance in Higher Education) and registered with EQAR (The European Quality Assurance Register for Higher Education - EQAR). Ireland’s NFQ is referenced both to the QF-EHEA (Qualification Frameworks - EHEA) and the EQF (The European Qualifications Framework (EQF) | Europass). The EQF spans all levels of the NFQ whereas QF-EHEA only spans the higher-education levels. Both QQI and providers of education and training programmes in Ireland are subject to the Standards and guidelines for quality assurance in the European Higher Education Area (ESG) for higher education. EQAVET ( EQAVET - European Quality Assurance in Vocational Education and Training - Employment, Social Affairs and Inclusion) is relevant to FET activity. the context of RPL is in scope. 5.21 Revision of ESG due in 2027 The second edition of the Standards and Guidelines for Quality Assurance in the European Higher Education Area (ESG), published in 2015, contains guidance on teaching, learning and assessment. QQI’s Assessment and Standards document aligns with the first edition of the ESG which was published in 2005. The 2015 version is significantly different from the 2005 version in respect of assessment. Topics related to assessment arise in many of the standards in Part 1 and not only in the standard dealing with teaching, learning and assessment. One difference is that there is a specific reference to upholding academic integrity and vigilance against academic fraud (standard 1.1). The current edition of the ESG is approaching ten years of age, is under review and is due to be replaced in 2027. A consultation draft was published in November 2025. The work ‘draws on the outcomes of the QA-FIT project’. 5.22 External quality assurance of assessment External examining and external authentication and external quality assurance by other agencies and parties have traditionally been key parts of the quality assurance infrastructure for assessment in higher education and further education respectively. For example, with a large proportion of the Irish population entering higher education each year inclusive assessment is now more important than ever. Inclusivity is necessary for validity because if an assessment of an intended learning outcome is not inclusive then failure in the assessment by a learner is not necessarily attributable to their failure to achieve the intended learning outcomes. Inclusive assessment that is aligned to well-crafted intended learning outcomes is an important contributor to the quality of teaching, learning opportunities and assessment. The availability to learners of powerful generative artificial intelligence tools complicates matters by constraining the approaches that can be used for high-stakes summative assessment. This challenges validity more generally and not only inclusivity. While designing for inclusivity (and validity more generally) is to be promoted it may not be possible to foresee all eventualities and therefore reasonable accommodations will need to be made. Inclusive assessment may be perceived to be more resource intensive than assessment that assumes all learners can be assessed in the same way (e.g. by an invigilated, fixed time, in-person written examination). Use of AI in education and vocational training is regarded as ‘high risk’ and among the activities listed under this heading is the following ‘AI systems intended to be used to evaluate learning outcomes, including when those outcomes are used to steer the learning process of natural persons in educational and vocational training institutions at all levels.’ High risk systems, for example, require human oversight (Article 14) and must ‘achieve an appropriate level of accuracy, robustness, and cybersecurity, and that they perform consistently in those respects throughout their lifecycle’ (Article 15). The Guidelines for the Responsible Use of Artificial Intelligence in the Public Service are also relevant. Regarding human oversight they state: All AI tools used in the public service must be part of a process that has human oversight built into it. This may include a human directly overseeing decisions in real time (“human-in-the-loop”), allowing the system to operate autonomously with the ability to be overridden or stopped by a human as needed (“human-on-the-loop”) or at a higher level (“human-in-command”). Alternative tilbud Det er ikke tillatt å levere alternative tilbud. Parallelle tilbud Det er ikke tillatt å levere parallelle tilbud. Hver leverandør kan ha ett gjeldende tilbud per delkontrakt. These risks range from personal data being stolen or inadvertently released and used by criminals to impersonate the individual, to worry being caused to individuals that their data will be used by MSLETB for unknown purposes. A Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA) describes a process designed to identify risks arising out of the processing of personal data and to minimise these risks as far and as early as possible. DPIAs are important tools for negating risk, and for demonstrating compliance with the GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation). Why do I need to carry out a DPIA? Pour ce qui concerne les critères de sélection et le cas échéant les règles et critères objectifs pour la limitation du nombre de candidats, les documents et certificats sont présentés au plus tard à la date ultime d’introduction des demandes de participation ou des offres. uelle du cessionnaire couvrira la totalité des prestations exécutées, en ce compris celles ayant déjà été exécutées par le cédant. Un adjudicataire qui, durant l’exécution du marché, ferait l’objet d’une procédure de réorganisation judiciaire (ou de toute situation similaire), s’engage expressément à ne pas suspendre ou interrompre l’exécution du marché (voir Art XX.56, § 1er et 2 du Code de droit économique). Succession On entend ici une succession universelle ou partielle de l’adjudicataire initial, à la suite d’opérations de restructuration de société, notamment de rachat, de fusion, d’acquisition ou d’insolvabilité, assurée par un autre opérateur économique qui remplit les critères de sélection établis initialement, à condition que cela n’entraîne pas d’autres modifications substantielles du marché. La règle « de minimis » Une modification peut être apportée au marché lorsque la valeur de la modification est inférieure au seuil fixé pour la publicité européenne et à dix pour cent de la valeur du marché initial. Lorsque plusieurs modifications successives sont effectuées, le montant est déterminé sur la base de la valeur cumulée nette des modifications successives. Verklaring aangaande de uitsluitingsgronden en/of selectiecriteria Impliciete verklaring op erewoord Door eenvoudig deel te nemen aan deze procedure tot gunning van de overheidsopdracht en door zijn aanvraag tot deelneming of offerte in te dienen, verklaart de kandidaat of inschrijver op erewoord zich niet in één van de voorziene uitsluitingsgevallen te bevinden als bedoeld in de Art 67, 68 en 69 van de wet. Wat de selectiecriteria betreft moeten de documenten en certificaten ten laatste op het uiterste tijdstip voor de indiening van de aanvragen tot deelneming of de offertes worden voorgelegd. Opmerking: de aanbestedende overheid gaat enkel voor de als opdrachtnemer in aanmerking komende inschrijver na of deze zich effectief niet in één van de voormelde uitsluitingsgevallen bevindt. De aanbestedende overheid zal in deze context een uittreksel strafregister opvragen van de natuurlijke persoon die de offerte/indieningsrapport heeft ondertekend, alsook van de rechtspersoon. Tevens behoudt ze zich het recht voor andere overtuigende stukken op te vragen. Wanneer meerdere ondernemingen deel uitmaakten van een combina

In dat geval legt hij de schriftelijke beschrijving van de genomen maatregelen voor. In het offertebiljet kan melding gemaakt worden van corrigerende maatregelen. Der NDR erteilt gegebenenfalls konkrete Vollmachten, damit der Auftragnehmer den NDR bei der Beschaffung der Genehmigung vertreten kann. 7 Schadensverhütung vor Ort (vgl. §§ 4 und 10 VOL/B) 7.1 Der Auftragnehmer ist verpflichtet, die staatlichen Arbeits- schutz- und Unfallverhütungsvorschriften sowie die all- gemein anerkannten sicherheitstechnischen und arbeits- medizinischen Regeln in vollem Umfang zu erfüllen. Der Auftragnehmer hat auf Anforderung des NDR einen entsprechenden Nachweis zu führen. Der Auftragnehmer sichert zu, dass die zu liefernden Geräte – soweit anwendbar – die grundlegenden Anforderungen der CE- Zertifizierung der Europäischen Union erfüllen und entsprechend gekennzeichnet sind. 7.2 Bei elektrischen Geräten und stromführenden Objekten (wie z.B. mobile Verteiler und Verlängerungskabel), die von Dienstleistern bzw. Auftragnehmern als notwendige Arbeitsmittel mit in Betriebsstätten des NDR gebracht werden, hat der Auftragnehmer eigenständig sicherzu- stellen, dass diese nach Maßgabe der DGUV Vorschrift 3 geprüft sind und damit betriebssicher eingesetzt werden können. references_experience.text: ncil can continue to fulfil its statutory function of distributing public funding to the arts sector securely, reliably, and efficiently. The objective of this procurement is to secure a modern, cloud-hosted, configurable off-the-shelf Grant Management System capable of supporting the full grant lifecycle for applicants, assessors, panellists, and Arts Council staff. The solution will provide a secure and accessible digital platform for application management, assessment workflows, award administration, post-award monitoring, reporting, and integration with the Arts Council’s existing Finance Management System. The organisation's strategic preference is for a solution that requires minimal custom development and can be configured using standard platform functionality. The replacement programme will be delivered through a phased implementation approach centred on the successful completion of a Proof of Concept (PoC) using a live Arts Council funding programme. This approach is intended to validate vendor capability, system performance, user experience, and organisational readiness before progressing to full production deployment. The Arts Council is seeking a long-term technology partner capable of delivering a proven solution while supporting a structured, low-risk transition from the e

Background and Objective The Arts Council is undertaking the replacement of its existing Grant Management System (GMS), a critical business application that underpins the administration, assessment, award, and ongoing management of public funding programmes. The current platform has been in operation beyond its supported lifecycle for over a decade and now presents significant operational, cybersecurity, governance, and business continuity risks. The replacement programme has therefore been established primarily as a risk mitigation and service continuity initiative to ensure the Arts Council can continue to fulfil its statutory function of distributing public funding to the arts sector securely, reliably, and efficiently. The objective of this procurement is to secure a modern, cloud-hosted, configurable off-the-shelf Grant Management System capable of supporting the full grant lifecycle for applicants, assessors, panellists, and Arts Council staff. The solution will provide a secure and accessible digital platform for application

e, user experience, and organisational readiness before progressing to full production deployment. The Arts Council is seeking a long-term technology partner capable of delivering a proven solution while supporting a structured, low-risk transition from the existing environment. The new system must support bilingual service delivery (Irish and English), modern digital user experiences, robust security controls, workflow automation, management reporting, and interoperability with current and future finance platforms. The solution should also align with public sector best practice, including cloud-first principles, accessibility requirements, data protection obligations, cybersecurity standards, and emerging NIS2 requirements. This procurement will be conducted through a Competitive Procedure with Negotiation to ensure transparency, value for money, and market competition. The successful solution will play a central role in enabling The Arts Council to maintain resilient grant administration services while providing a platform for future enhancement and digital innovation across the organisation. Hij/zij ondersteunt de projectleiding bij architecturale beslissingen, planning, risicoanalyse, kwaliteitsbewaking en technische governance. Hij/zij begeleidt configuratie- en implementatieteams en staat, waar nodig, zelf mee in voor configuratie. De projecten zijn meestal nieuwe ontwikkelingsopdrachten of grote onderhoudsopdrachten voor de organisatie. Scope of this Procurement The P2W SKILLNET will require DPS Members who are capable of providing courses within the scope of requirements for each Lot specified below. Requirements for board certification of competency of our trainees include broad exposure to and experience with pediatric and adult genetic disorders, including metabolic and mitochondrial disorders, complex traits, skeletal dysplasia’s, clefting, phacomatoses, and chromosomal disorders. The training must include information on the diagnosis and management of these disorders, including the opportunity to rotate in CLIA approved diagnostic genetic laboratories run by American Board of Medical Genetics (ABMG) certified staff. Another component must be the follow up of abnormal newborn screening results. Residents spend two of the 5 years training in Pediatrics at Children’s National Hospital, a world-renowned institution in metropolitan Washington, D.C. The pediatrics training is based in a diverse, urban setting and includes training experiences in the surrounding capital region. The curriculum includes rotations in subspecialty pediatrics, PICU, NICU, emergency medicine, well baby nursery, as well as inpatient and outpatient general pediatrics. Graduates are eligible to sit for the ABP board examination and well equipped to work in primary care and pediatric subspecialties. To meet these requirements the Medical Genetics Branch and OCD seek ne

OCD seek nearby institutions to provide these components of training for board certification in Clinical Genetics, Clinical Biochemical Genetics, Medical Biochemical Genetics, Clinical Molecular Genetics and Clinical Cytogenetics. In addition, trainees need to have training in applicable laboratory techniques and the clinical interpretation and implications of the test results. The staff must also participate in the comprehensive teaching of residents, including participation in lecture series, journal clubs, and case conferences. Assessment is also in very much scope and there has been substantial work done on assessment in the past. 4.10 International landscape Ireland is part of the European Higher Education Area, the European Research Area. Irish agencies and educational institutions are networked internationally. QQI, for example, is a member of ENQA (The European Association for Quality Assurance in Higher Education) and registered with EQAR (The European Quality Assurance Register for Higher Education - EQAR). Ireland’s NFQ is referenced both to the QF-EHEA (Qualification Frameworks - EHEA) and the EQF (The European Qualifications Framework (EQF) | Europass). The EQF spans all levels of the NFQ whereas QF-EHEA only spans the higher-education levels. Both QQI and providers of education and training programmes in Ireland are subject to the Standards and guidelines for quality assurance in the European Higher Education Area (ESG) for higher education. EQAVET ( EQAVET - European Quality Assurance in Vocational Education and Training - Employment, Social Affairs and Inclusion) is relevant to FET activity. the context of RPL is in scope. 5.21 Revision of ESG due in 2027 The second edition of the Standards and Guidelines for Quality Assurance in the European Higher Education Area (ESG), published in 2015, contains guidance on teaching, learning and assessment. QQI’s Assessment and Standards document aligns with the first edition of the ESG which was published in 2005. The 2015 version is significantly different from the 2005 version in respect of assessment. Topics related to assessment arise in many of the standards in Part 1 and not only in the standard dealing with teaching, learning and assessment. One difference is that there is a specific reference to upholding academic integrity and vigilance against academic fraud (standard 1.1). The current edition of the ESG is approaching ten years of age, is under review and is due to be replaced in 2027. A consultation draft was published in November 2025. The work ‘draws on the outcomes of the QA-FIT project’. 5.22 External quality assurance of assessment External examining and external authentication and external quality assurance by other agencies and parties have traditionally been key parts of the quality assurance infrastructure for assessment in higher education and further education respectively. Now is a good time to take stock of these

For example, with a large proportion of the Irish population entering higher education each year inclusive assessment is now more important than ever. Inclusivity is necessary for validity because if an assessment of an intended learning outcome is not inclusive then failure in the assessment by a learner is not necessarily attributable to their failure to achieve the intended learning outcomes. Inclusive assessment that is aligned to well-crafted intended learning outcomes is an important contributor to the quality of teaching, learning opportunities and assessment. The availability to learners of powerful generative artificial intelligence tools complicates matters by constraining the approaches that can be used for high-stakes summative assessment. This challenges validity more generally and not only inclusivity. While designing for inclusivity (and validity more generally) is to be promoted it may not be possible to foresee all eventualities and therefore reasonable accommodations will need to be made. Inclusive assessment may be perceived to be more resource intensive than assessment that assumes all learners can be assessed in the same way (e.g. by an invigilated, fixed time, in-person written examination). Use of AI in education and vocational training is regarded as ‘high risk’ and among the activities listed under this heading is the following ‘AI systems intended to be used to evaluate learning outcomes, including when those outcomes are used to steer the learning process of natural persons in educational and vocational training institutions at all levels.’ High risk systems, for example, require human oversight (Article 14) and must ‘achieve an appropriate level of accuracy, robustness, and cybersecurity, and that they perform consistently in those respects throughout their lifecycle’ (Article 15). The Guidelines for the Responsible Use of Artificial Intelligence in the Public Service are also relevant. Regarding human oversight they state: All AI tools used in the public service must be part of a process that has human oversight built into it. This may include a human directly overseeing decisions in real time (“human-in-the-loop”), allowing the system to operate autonomously with the ability to be overridden or stopped by a human as needed (“human-on-the-loop”) or at a higher level (“human-in-command”). Alternative tilbud Det er ikke tillatt å levere alternative tilbud. Parallelle tilbud Det er ikke tillatt å levere parallelle tilbud. Hver leverandør kan ha ett gjeldende tilbud per delkontrakt.
